_about: ONE table for the Python/JS mirror of a feed card's page key (Task 28 fix round 1, B2).
feedProgramKey (site/src/lib/feed-model.mjs) and _feed_program_key (src/govbudget/export_site.py) must give `key` for every `card`;
feedCardHasProgramPage (JS) and the section sidecar emitter _emit_feed_section_sidecars (Python) must give `has_program_page` over `program_pages`.
Read by site/scripts/gates/__tests__/feed-program-key.test.mjs AND tests/test_feed_program_key_mirror.py. Change a case here and both suites re-check it.
program_pages stands in for the program_details/ listing: bare shared codes (2292, 3010) have no sidecar; their members do.

cases.name: ordinary code with no page (an event on a code no program page covers)
member card: one member of a shared code carries every link (Task 28a)
bare stub: a card addressed to a shared code's bare page, which is not built
no program_url: the key falls back to pe_bli
company card: no pe_bli, no page
card with no pe_bli field at all
empty pe_bli is a key that names no page
empty program_url falls back to pe_bli
malformed url: the /programs/ index, not a program page
malformed url: an empty key segment
malformed url: a trailing newline (neither side anchors before it)
